notes: Minecraft Y is now an absolute MSE rendering coordinate; the old logical Y + 1 adapter offset is retired.
Y=2 is the default Mindustry surface in Minecraft. Y=0 and negative Y remain valid for future underground systems.
The target Minecraft world should be empty so the Relay can reconstruct the Mindustry world without pre-existing terrain conflicts.
Floor and wall semantics come from the World State layer/kind, not from requiring unique Minecraft materials. A floor and a wall may intentionally share a material.
Shallow fluids render at Y=2 over a bed at Y=1. Deep fluids may also occupy Y=1 with their bed at Y=0.
Coordinate transforms are explicit so mirrored maps can be calibrated without changing protocol code.
Set flip_x or flip_z after the calibration map identifies the mirrored axis.
Snapshot authority is provisional for the Minecraft-Mindustry MVP.
